_note: Controller numbers (src/game/gamepad.ts). The browser's Gamepad API gives each stick axis as -1..1 and each trigger as 0..1; the thresholds below are fractions of that travel. Where the legacy game publishes a value it is noted; the rest are ours.
_moveThreshold: the left stick counts as a movement key past this deflection, so every movement rule sees what a keyboard gives
_triggerThreshold: a trigger counts as pulled past this much of its travel
_autoSprintAt: with auto sprint on, a forward push past this sprints
_holdTime: seconds a button with a hold (Y: holster, D-pad left: inspect) must be down before the hold goes instead of the tap
_edge: the right stick is at its edge from here, where the advanced look's extra turn ramps in
_look: the simple look: yaw degrees a second per sensitivity level at full deflection (3 is 180, where the legacy game's ALC yaw defaults) and pitch as a share of yaw
_adsBase: the ADS level that leaves the zoom scaling alone (the mouse's own rule)
_defaults: what a new player gets. deadzone and outerDeadzone are fractions of the stick; exponent is the Classic curve's power (1 is Linear, higher is finer near the centre). A stick rarely reaches a full 1.0 on the diagonal or when worn, so the outer deadzone treats the last 2% as full.
